title: Replace bullet splitting engine with smart semantic splitting

requirements.summary: Remove all existing bullet point splitting logic from notesCleanerFormat.ts
acceptanceCriteria: All previous splitting logic is completely removed from notesCleanerFormat.ts
No traces of the old conjunction-based splitting remain in the codebase

file_operations.description: Remove convertToParagraphToPoints, convertToBulletPoints, and all definition style bullet formatting functions. Delete all existing conjunction-based splitting logic including CONNECTING_WORDS array, sentence splitting by 'and', and any bullet point generation based on conjunctions. Preserve only the headings auto-detect functionality (detectHeadings function) and basic text processing utilities.

requirements.summary: Implement semantic phrase detection that preserves scientific compound terms as single bullets
acceptanceCriteria: Phrases containing 'and' within scientific/technical contexts remain as single bullets
Scientific compound terms with modifiers stay intact
Example 'carbon dioxide and water' produces one bullet, not two

file_operations.description: Add semanticPhraseDetection function that identifies and protects scientific compound terms from splitting. Implement pattern recognition for: compound chemical names (e.g., 'carbon dioxide and water'), scientific technical phrases with 'and' (e.g., 'low solute concentration and high solute concentration'), phrases with dependent modifiers (e.g., 'semi permeable membrane'), and descriptive clauses containing conjunctions. Create a whitelist of protected phrase patterns and a function to mark these phrases as atomic units that must never be split across bullet points.

requirements.summary: Implement smart splitting logic that creates multiple bullets only for sequential standalone technical phrases without conjunctions
acceptanceCriteria: Input 'light absorption glucose formation oxygen release' produces three separate bullets
Each bullet is a complete phrase (e.g., 'Light absorption by chlorophyll')
Sequential phrases without conjunctions are correctly identified and split

file_operations.description: Add smartSequentialSplitting function that detects 2 or more standalone technical phrases appearing sequentially without conjunctions (and/or/with/of/from/to/in/by/using/through). Implement noun phrase detection to identify technical terms and process names. Split only when multiple standalone phrases are detected in sequence without connecting words. Ensure each resulting bullet is a complete, meaningful phrase by applying minimal context expansion (e.g., adding implied verbs or subjects where grammatically necessary).

requirements.summary: Preserve complete sentences as single bullets when they contain subject + verb + descriptive clause
acceptanceCriteria: Sentences with clear subject-verb-object structure remain as single bullets
Process explanations are not fragmented mid-explanation
Descriptive clauses stay attached to their subjects

file_operations.description: Add sentenceStructureAnalysis function that identifies complete sentences with subject + verb + object/descriptive clause patterns. Detect process explanations (sentences describing how something works or occurs) and mark them as atomic units. Implement clause attachment detection to ensure descriptive clauses, relative clauses, and explanatory phrases remain attached to their subjects. Prevent splitting of sentences that contain full grammatical structures even if they include conjunctions within the sentence.

requirements.summary: Implement validation rules to prevent single-word bullets, conjunction-led bullets, and modifier-separated bullets
acceptanceCriteria: No bullet contains only a single word
No bullet begins with a standalone conjunction
Modifiers are not separated from their nouns into different bullets

file_operations.description: Add validateBulletQuality function that filters and repairs invalid bullets. Implement checks for: single-word bullets (reject or merge with adjacent context), bullets starting with standalone conjunctions like 'and', 'or', 'but' (merge with previous bullet), and modifier-noun separation (detect adjective-noun pairs and ensure they stay together). Apply validation as a post-processing step after semantic splitting and merge or discard invalid bullets according to the rules. Ensure validation runs in all three conversion modes.

requirements.summary: Apply semantic grouping before bullet conversion and prioritize meaning preservation in all conversion modes
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic analysis completes before any bullet formatting is applied
All three conversion modes use the same smart semantic engine
Meaning of academic content is preserved even if fewer bullets are generated
Logical phrase boundaries are respected across all conversion modes

file_operations.description: Implement semanticBulletEngine function that orchestrates the semantic analysis pipeline: (1) Apply semanticPhraseDetection to protect compound terms, (2) Apply sentenceStructureAnalysis to identify complete sentences, (3) Apply smartSequentialSplitting only to eligible text segments, (4) Apply validateBulletQuality to filter results. Re-implement convertToParagraphToPoints using semanticBulletEngine. Re-implement convertToBulletPoints using semanticBulletEngine. Re-implement definition style formatting using semanticBulletEngine. Ensure meaning preservation is the primary objective with formatting as secondary. Return fewer, more meaningful bullets rather than over-splitting content.

Verify that NotesCleanerPage.tsx correctly calls the updated convertToParagraphToPoints, convertToBulletPoints, and definition style functions from notesCleanerFormat.ts. Ensure the three conversion buttons (Convert Paragraph to Points, Convert to Bullet Points, Definition Style Format) all use the new semantic engine. No changes to UI layout, Download Button, Reset Output Button, or Headings Auto Detect functionality per constraints.
